newsitem.title: UK: Gallaher dips, Hoare Govett repeats "hold".
newsitem.headline: Gallaher dips, Hoare Govett repeats "hold".

text.p: Shares in British cigarette maker Gallaher Group Plc edged lower on Thursday as analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett repeated a "hold" recommendation on the stock and trimmed earnings estimates, dealers said.
The stock was quoted down 5p at 256 by 0943 GMT in thin volume of just 378,659 shares.

Analysts at Hoare Govett played down their earnings changes, saying they were no more than a minor adjustment reflecting a rise in excise duties in the budget earlier this month. They declined further comment.
